edit_summary: Round-2 remedies. Both Criticals (reviewer A AC-OBSERVABLE 789, reviewer B CONTRADICTION 790) came from one defect: TEST-026 was annotated as a named SKIP whose gating condition AC-034's merged()/fingerprint_match() grammar cannot express and whose row AC-034 does not list, so AC-035(b)'s unknown-SKIP hard-fail would trip on it. Withdrawn: TEST-026's Test Type column returns to 'integration', byte-identical to its pre-round-2 value, and AC-026's pointer loses the sentence asserting 'TEST-026 is therefore a named SKIP', replaced by a statement that the criterion carries no SKIP disposition and is not governed by AC-034's allowlist. Reviewer B's additional fact is recorded: TEST-026 also covers TEST-018, the Context-absent case, which depends on no upstream epic at all, so no variant of the SKIP framing fits. Untouched, because both reviewers confirmed them working: AC-026's point-of-use disclosure pointer, TEST-026's Notes disclosure with its (OQ-004) pointer, and the appended OQ-004/Risks precision correction. investigation.md 63/0, acceptance-tests.md 1/1 (the Notes disclosure), requirements.md 6/3 (the withdrawn sentence cannot be removed by appending).
